title: Wingman — score and squadron ranking
description: Design 018: the score of every round from the end-of-round PERFORMANCE panel, by period, with a marker for each change that can affect play. Below it, the resource trail of every session (Performance 008): memory, threads, open files and OCR time per sample, and each session's growth.

target.rawSql:
SELECT at AS time, label AS text, ref AS tags
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
ORDER BY at

list.name: granularity
list.label: Granularity
list.description: The period each bar and table row covers (week: ISO, from Monday).

list.name: aggregate
list.label: Aggregate
list.query: sum : sum(x),mean : avg(x),median : percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x),count : count(x),min : min(x),max : max(x)
list.description: What each period shows of the metric over its read rounds.

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: The figure from the PERFORMANCE panel.

list.name: window
list.label: Moving average
list.description: Read rounds in the moving average.

list.name: tags
list.label: Tags
list.description: A JSON object of tags to match; {} matches every round.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query:
SELECT coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') FROM rounds
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

list.description: The wingman versions the OCR and reaction timing panels show.

panels.title: Totals in range
panels.description: Wingman's own rounds over the time range: flown, read, and the score of the read ones. Rounds with a manual takeover are counted apart and left out of the rest. Compare means only where nearly every round was read.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds flown",
       count(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds read",
       coalesce(sum(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0), 0) AS "total score",
       round((avg(score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0))::numeric, 1) AS "mean per read round",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score) FILTER (WHERE manual_takeovers = 0)
           AS "median per read round",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT manual_takeovers = 0) AS "rounds taken over"
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb

panels.title: Squadron now
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's latest reading in the time range: its rank on the game's squadron leaderboard (lower is better), its trophies, and how long ago wingman read them in the lobby (ADR 166). The two squadron charts below draw every reading.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT read_at, rank, trophies
  FROM squadron_rankings
  WHERE $__timeFilter(read_at)
  ORDER BY read_at DESC
  LIMIT 1)
SELECT rank AS "rank", trophies AS "trophies", read_at AS "read"
FROM latest

panels.title: Score per round: wingman and manual takeover
panels.description: Every read round at the time it ended. Wingman's own rounds are dots, one colour per account (no account, a round rebuilt from a log that names none), with the mean of their last $window read rounds over all accounts (blue line); rounds with a manual takeover are orange, with their own moving average. The operator expects the takeover rounds to score higher, and the two lines to close as wingman improves (2026-10-29). Hover a dot for its account, jet and K/D/A; the time in that tooltip is the nearest round's, not always the dot's. Where dots crowd, narrow the time range first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time,
       CASE WHEN manual_takeovers = 0 THEN '' ELSE 'manual takeover, ' END
         || coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') || ', '
         || coalesce(jet, 'jet not recorded')
         || ', K/D/A ' || kills || '/' || deaths || '/' || assists AS metric,
       score AS value
FROM rounds LEFT JOIN jet_names ON spelling = tags->>'jet'
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') AS metric,
       score AS value
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       avg(score) OVER (ORDER BY ended_at ROWS BETWEEN ${window:raw} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "wingman, moving average"
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       score AS "manual takeover",
       avg(score) OVER (ORDER BY ended_at ROWS BETWEEN ${window:raw} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "manual takeover, moving average"
FROM rounds
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND NOT manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Score range by jet (tick at the mean)
panels.description: Wingman's own rounds by the jet on record (ADR 167 and 168), the jet with the most read rounds on the left. Each bar runs from the jet's lowest score to its highest, and the tick marks its mean. Hover a bar for its figures and its count of read rounds: a jet with few rounds can have a short bar for that reason alone. Rounds with no jet recorded and rounds with a manual takeover are left out. OCR's spellings of one jet, such as F-106 and F106 DELTA DART, count as one jet under its most common spelling (jet_names in grafana/schema.sql).

targets.rawSql:
WITH jets AS (
  SELECT jet,
         count(*) AS rounds,
         min(score) AS lowest,
         avg(score) AS mean,
         max(score) AS highest
  FROM rounds JOIN jet_names ON spelling = tags->>'jet'
  WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND tags->>'jet' IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
    AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
  GROUP BY 1
), ticks AS (
  SELECT *, greatest(mean - 0.01 * max(highest) OVER (), 0) AS tick_from,
            0.02 * max(highest) OVER () AS tick
  FROM jets
)
SELECT jet AS "Jet",
       least(lowest, tick_from) AS "below the lowest",
       tick_from - least(lowest, tick_from) AS "lowest to mean",
       tick AS "mean tick",
       greatest(highest - tick_from - tick, 0) AS "mean to highest",
       highest AS "Highest",
       round(mean) AS "Mean score",
       lowest AS "Lowest",
       rounds AS "Rounds read"
FROM ticks
ORDER BY rounds DESC, mean DESC

matcher.options: /^(below the lowest|lowest to mean|mean tick|mean to highest)$/

panels.title: Squadron rank per reading (lower is better)
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's place on the game's squadron leaderboard at each reading. Wingman reads it in the lobby between rounds (ADR 166). A lower number is a better place. It is the squadron's own figure, so it does not depend on the account that read it, and the tags box does not apply. The axis runs from the worst place at the foot to the best at the top, so the line climbs as the squadron climbs and lines up with the trophies beside it. Grafana has no reversed axis, so the chart plots the rank negated: the axis labels carry a minus sign, and the tooltip shows the real place.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT read_at AS time, rank AS "rank"
FROM squadron_rankings
WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(read_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Squadron trophies per reading
panels.description: Mobius Squadron's trophy count at each reading: the whole squadron's, every member included, not wingman's alone. It does not depend on the account that read it, and the tags box does not apply (ADR 166).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT read_at AS time, trophies AS "trophies"
FROM squadron_rankings
WHERE trophies IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(read_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Account and jet score per round
panels.description: Wingman's own read rounds for the accounts and jets picked in the Account and Jet boxes at the top, to follow one jet on one account over time. A dot is a round at the time it ended, in its account's colour; hover it for the account and jet. The legend lists only the line: with many accounts and jets it would crowd out the chart. The blue line is the mean of the last $window rounds of the whole selection, so pick one account and one jet to see that jet's own trend. Rounds with a manual takeover are left out. The tags box applies too. A jet with a few dozen rounds moves a lot on each new one: score per round has a standard deviation near 200.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time,
       coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') || ', ' || coalesce(jet, 'jet not recorded') AS metric,
       score AS value
FROM rounds LEFT JOIN jet_names ON spelling = tags->>'jet'
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') IN (${account:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(jet, 'not recorded') IN (${jet:sqlstring})
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ended_at AS time,
       avg(score) OVER (ORDER BY ended_at ROWS BETWEEN ${window:raw} - 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "selection, moving average"
FROM rounds LEFT JOIN jet_names ON spelling = tags->>'jet'
WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND manual_takeovers = 0 AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND coalesce(tags->>'account', 'no account') IN (${account:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(jet, 'not recorded') IN (${jet:sqlstring})
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wingman by jet
panels.description: Wingman's own rounds by the jet on the lobby as PLAY was clicked (ADR 167), the best mean score first. Kills, deaths and assists are per round. ± 95% is the margin on the mean: trust a gap between two jets only when their ranges do not overlap. A jet with under 10 read rounds comes after the rest, because so few prove little. A jet can fly on several accounts; narrow to one with the tags box. Rounds flown before 2026-10-31 have no jet recorded. OCR's spellings of one jet, such as F-106 and F106 DELTA DART, count as one jet under its most common spelling (jet_names in grafana/schema.sql).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(jet, 'not recorded') AS "Jet",
       count(*) AS "Rounds flown",
       count(score) AS "Rounds read",
       round(avg(score)) AS "Mean score",
       round(1.96 * stddev_samp(score) / sqrt(count(score))) AS "± 95%",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score) AS "Median score",
       round(avg(kills), 1) AS "Kills",
       round(avg(deaths), 1) AS "Deaths",
       round(avg(assists), 1) AS "Assists"
FROM rounds LEFT JOIN jet_names ON spelling = tags->>'jet'
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY jet
ORDER BY jet IS NULL, count(score) < 10, "Mean score" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: ${aggregate:text} of $metric per $granularity
panels.description: The chosen aggregate over every read round that ended in each period (America/New_York). An unread round adds nothing; Rounds per period counts it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS time,
       ${aggregate:raw} AS "${aggregate:text} of $metric"
FROM (SELECT ended_at, ${metric:raw} AS x
      FROM rounds
      WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
        AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb) AS r
WHERE x IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rounds per $granularity
panels.description: Rounds read and not read in each period; together, the rounds flown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS time,
       count(score) AS "rounds read",
       count(*) - count(score) AS "rounds not read"
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Periods
panels.description: One row per $granularity: rounds flown and read, and the sum, mean, median, minimum and maximum of $metric over the read rounds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$granularity', ended_at, '$tz') AS period,
       count(*) AS "rounds flown",
       count(score) AS "rounds read",
       sum(${metric:raw}) AS sum,
       round(avg(${metric:raw})::numeric, 1) AS mean,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ${metric:raw}) AS median,
       min(${metric:raw}) AS min,
       max(${metric:raw}) AS max
FROM rounds
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Tags
panels.description: Each tag key and value among the rounds in range, with its count of rounds. Filter with the tags box, for example {"account": "mobius0"}.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.key AS tag, t.value, count(*) AS rounds
FROM rounds, jsonb_each_text(rounds.tags) AS t(key, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND manual_takeovers = 0
  AND tags @> ${tags:sqlstring}::jsonb
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Memory per sample (MB)
panels.description: Wingman's resident memory, the game's (summed over its processes, so read it as a trend, not a footprint), and glibc's split of wingman's heap: malloc live is memory wingman is using, malloc retained is memory it freed that the allocator kept. Live climbing means something holds objects; retained climbing means fragmentation. From the RESOURCE line wingman logs every 5 minutes (wingman/resource_monitor.py, Performance 008), read from the session logs by the ingest. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at AS time,
       rss_mb AS "wingman rss",
       game_rss_mb AS "game rss",
       mi_use_mb AS "malloc live",
       mi_free_mb AS "malloc retained"
FROM resource_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Threads and open files per sample
panels.description: Wingman's live Python threads and open file descriptors. Threads climbing means daemon threads are not reaped; open files climbing means leaked X Display connections. From the RESOURCE line wingman logs every 5 minutes (wingman/resource_monitor.py, Performance 008), read from the session logs by the ingest. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at AS time, threads AS "threads", fds AS "open files"
FROM resource_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OCR time per sample
panels.description: The median and 95th percentile of wingman's OCR reads in the 5 minutes before each sample. Rising with memory is how the leak degraded perception (Performance 008); the tick budget is 1.5 s. From the RESOURCE line wingman logs every 5 minutes (wingman/resource_monitor.py, Performance 008), read from the session logs by the ingest. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at AS time, ocr_med AS "median", ocr_p95 AS "p95"
FROM resource_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resources per session
panels.description: One row per session with at least two samples (the summary needs two; a session wingman restarted within 5 minutes has one), any of them in the time range, newest first, figures in MB. Wingman and Game are each process's memory at the last sample; both start near 680 and 500 MB. The rates match the RESOURCE SUMMARY wingman logs at the end of a session: from the first sample after the 10-minute warm-up (the OCR readers load in the first 5 minutes) to the last, so they are blank for a session under 10 minutes. Orange is above the 50 MB/h the summary calls growth, red above its 1,000 MB/h severity bar. Trim released is what malloc_trim gave back when the session went to STANDBY. The verdict is the summary's own; a session that was killed has none. From the RESOURCE line wingman logs every 5 minutes (wingman/resource_monitor.py, Performance 008), read from the session logs by the ingest. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
WITH picked AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session_start FROM resource_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at)
), agg AS (
    SELECT s.session_start,
           count(*) AS samples,
           max(elapsed_s) AS last_s,
           min(elapsed_s) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_s >= 600) AS anchor_s,
           (array_agg(rss_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] AS rss_last,
           (array_agg(rss_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_s >= 600))[1] AS rss_anchor,
           (array_agg(game_rss_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] AS game_last,
           (array_agg(game_rss_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_s >= 600))[1] AS game_anchor,
           max(peak_rss_mb) AS peak,
           (array_agg(mi_use_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] AS live_last,
           (array_agg(mi_free_mb ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] AS retained_last,
           (array_agg(threads ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] - (array_agg(threads ORDER BY elapsed_s))[1] AS threads_d,
           (array_agg(fds ORDER BY elapsed_s DESC))[1] - (array_agg(fds ORDER BY elapsed_s))[1] AS fds_d
    FROM resource_samples s JOIN picked USING (session_start)
    GROUP BY s.session_start
    HAVING count(*) >= 2
)
SELECT a.session_start AS "Start",
       coalesce(x.tags->>'account', 'no account') AS "Account",
       round(a.last_s / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours",
       a.samples AS "Samples",
       a.rss_last AS "Wingman",
       round((a.rss_last - a.rss_anchor) * 3600.0 / nullif(a.last_s - a.anchor_s, 0)) AS "Wingman MB/h",
       a.peak AS "Wingman peak",
       a.game_last AS "Game",
       round((a.game_last - a.game_anchor) * 3600.0 / nullif(a.last_s - a.anchor_s, 0)) AS "Game MB/h",
       a.live_last AS "Malloc live",
       a.retained_last AS "Malloc retained",
       a.threads_d AS "Threads +",
       a.fds_d AS "Open files +",
       x.trim_released_mb AS "Trim released",
       x.verdict AS "Verdict"
FROM agg a LEFT JOIN resource_sessions x USING (session_start)
ORDER BY a.session_start DESC

panels.title: OCR time per crop per session
panels.description: Each session's mean OCR read time for each crop, one point per session at its start. The 1.5 s tick bounds them all; incoming is the one a missile warning waits on. From PerformanceTracker's run file of each session (docs/performance/current and release, run_*.json), loaded by the ingest; the figures the runtime trend HTML charted (tests/runtime_performance_tracking.py). The Version box narrows them to the versions picked. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, figure AS metric, mean AS value
FROM run_timings
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND wingman_version IN (${version:sqlstring})
  AND figure <> 'reaction'
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Missile warning to flares per session
panels.description: Each session's time from the incoming-missile warning on screen to the flare press: its mean and 95th percentile, one point per session at its start. From PerformanceTracker's run file of each session (docs/performance/current and release, run_*.json), loaded by the ingest; the figures the runtime trend HTML charted (tests/runtime_performance_tracking.py). The Version box narrows them to the versions picked. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, mean AS "mean", p95 AS "p95"
FROM run_timings
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND wingman_version IN (${version:sqlstring})
  AND figure = 'reaction'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OCR and reaction time by version
panels.description: One row per wingman version with a session in the time range, newest first: the runtime trend HTML's figures. Each crop's time and warning to flares are means over every read or warning of the version's sessions, weighted by count, as the HTML weighted them. Warning to flares p95 is the median of the sessions' own 95th percentiles, since percentiles do not add up. Widen the time range to bring older versions in. From PerformanceTracker's run file of each session (docs/performance/current and release, run_*.json), loaded by the ingest; the figures the runtime trend HTML charted (tests/runtime_performance_tracking.py). The Version box narrows them to the versions picked. The figures are the machine's, not an account's, so the tags box does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT wingman_version AS "Version",
       count(DISTINCT run_id) AS "Sessions",
       sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'incoming') AS "Incoming reads",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'incoming')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'incoming'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "incoming",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'respawn')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'respawn'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "respawn",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'health')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'health'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "health",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'ammo_flares')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'ammo_flares'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "ammo_flares",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'ammo_missiles')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'ammo_missiles'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "ammo_missiles",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'telemetry')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'telemetry'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "telemetry",
       sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'reaction') AS "Warnings",
       round((sum(mean * n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'reaction')
              / nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'reaction'), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "warning to flares",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p95)
              FILTER (WHERE figure = 'reaction'))::numeric, 3) AS "warning to flares p95"
FROM run_timings
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND wingman_version IN (${version:sqlstring})
GROUP BY wingman_version
ORDER BY CASE WHEN wingman_version ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*$'
     THEN string_to_array(wingman_version, '.')::int[] END DESC NULLS LAST
